title: Dortn Dortn (Over There, Over There)
description: Folk song (textual variant published in 1901 by S. Ginzburg and P. Marek; one version published in 1918 by M. Kipnis). This version was published in 1927 by Y.L. Cahan.
lyrics_original:
אױ, דאָרטן, דאָרטן, איבערן װאַסערל,
אױ, דאָרטן, דאָרטן, איבערן בריק!
פֿאַרטריבן האָסטו מיך אין די װײַטענע לענדער,
און בענקען, בענק איך נאַך דיר צוריק!

אױ,וױפֿל אָװנטן צוזאַמען געזעסן,
אױ, װיפֿל אָװנטן שפּעט אין דער נאַכט!
און װיפֿל טרערעלעך מיר האָבן בײדע פֿאַרגאָסן
אײדער מיר האָבן די ליבע צוזאַמענגעבראַכט!

אױ, העלף מיר גאָטעניו, אױ, גאָט אין הימל,
העלף מיר, גאָטעניו, ס’איז מיר ניט גוט;
שױן צװײ-דרײַ יאָרעלעך, וױ מיר שפּילן אַ ליבע,
און אױסשפּילן די ליבע קאַנען מיר ניט!

אױ, דײַנע אײגעלעך, אַזױ װי די קאַרשעלעך,
און דײַנע ליפּעלעך, וױ ראָזעװע פּאַפּיר;
און דײַנע פֿינגערלעך, װי טינט און װי פֿעדער —
אױ, שרײַבן זאָלסטו אָפֿטע בריװ צו מיר!
lyrics_transliterated:
Oy, dortn, dortn, ibern vaserl,
Oy, dortn, dortn, ibern brik!
Fartribn hostu mikh in di vaytene lender,
Un benken benk ikh nokh dir tsurik!

Oy, vifl ovntn tsuzamen gezesn,
Oy, vifl ovntn shpet in der nakht!
Un vifl trerelekh mir hobn beyde fargosn
Eyder mir hobn di libe tsuzamengebrakht!

Oy, helf mir, gotenyu, oy, got in himl,
Helf mir, gotenyu, s’iz mir nit gut!
Shoyn tsayt dray yorelekh, vi mir shpiln a libe,
Un oysshpiln di libe konen mir nit!

Oy, dayne eygelekh, azoy vi di karshelekh,
Un dayne lipelekh, vi rozeve papir;
Un dayne fiogerlekh, vi tint un vi feder­-
Oy, shraybn zolstu ofte briv tsu mir!
lyrics_english:
Oh there, there, beyond the ocean,
Oh there, there, beyond the bridge!
You have driven me off to far away countries
And I yearn, I yearn for you back home!

Oh, how many evenings we sat together
oh, how many evenings, late into the night!
And how many tears we both shed
before we joined our loves together!

Oh, help me, my God, oh God in heaven,
help me, my God, I’m not doing well!
It’s already three years since we began our love affair
and we cannot bring it to completion!

Oh, your eyes are like black cherries,
let your lips be like rose-colored paper;
and your fingers like pen and ink —
so you can write to me often!

title: Oyf yener zayt
lyrics_transliterated:
Oyf yener zayt

Der mentsh shtraybt nor tsu vern raykh, er vendt ton di shlekhte zakh
Er shvindlt, rayst di hoyt fun aykh, abi nor tsu krign gelt a sakh
Nor plutsim kumt aroys der sod, der khokhem vert gor bankrupt
In keytelekh firt men im gants vayt in prison fun yener zayt, fun yener zayt, fun yener zayt

Vayl mentshele, bist keynmol nit zat
Tsulib dos gelt roybstu oremelayt
Meynst vest lebn eybik, du nar, oy vestu krign eyn psak derfar
In keyver dort af yener zayt
lyrics_english:
Man strives only to become rich, he turns to doing wicked things
He swindles, tears the skin from you just to get a lot of money
But suddenly comes the secret, the "wise" fellow goes bankrupt
They carry him off in chains, far away, in prison, on the other side

Because you, little man, are never sated
You rob poor people just for money
You think you'll live forever, you fool, but you'll get your punishment for it
In the grave, there on the other side

lyrics_transliterated:
A glezele lekhayim, ez shod nit nemen haynt,
ven me zitst bay a yontevdikn tish.
A glezele lekhayim far frayndshaft un far fraynt,
me zol shtendik nor munter zayn un frish.
A glezele lekhayim far alt un yung vos zitsn do,
un far yedern bazunder vos zaynen haynt mit undz nito.
A glezele lekhayim, der bekher ful mit vayn,
far der zun, zi zol shtendik mit undz zayn.

A glezele lekhayim trinken mir atsind,
nor oyf simkhes bay yedern fun aykh.
A glezele lekhayim far muter un far kind,
az mit nakhes di mame zol zayn raykh.
A glezele lekhayim, nit opshteyn zol fun aykh di shayn,
keyn shvartser tog in lebn in der mishpokhe zol nit zayn.
A glezele lekhayim iz oystrinken keday,
ven me zet zikh mit fraynd oyf dos nay.

A glezele lekhayim, far unzer groyser land,
iber unz zol der himl kukn reyn.
A glezele lekhayim, ikh vintsh aykh nokh anand,
mit a shmeykhl oyf di lipn zolt ir geyn.
A glezele lekhayim, begleytn zol aykh shtendik freyd,
mit laybik un munter, ir zolt keynmol nit tsesheyd.
A glezele lekhayim, far alts vos unz gefelt
un far sholem oyf gor der gantser velt.
column11:
A little glass of l’chaim, it’s a shame not to take one today,
when one sits at a festive holiday table.
A little glass of l’chaim for friendship and for friends,
may we always be cheerful and fresh.
A little glass of l’chaim for the old and the young who sit here,
and for each one in particular who is not with us today.
A little glass of l’chaim, the goblet full of wine,
for the sun—may it always be with us.

A little glass of l’chaim we drink now,
only for celebrations for each of you.
A little glass of l’chaim for mother and for child,
so that the mama may be rich in naches (proud joy).
A little glass of l’chaim—may the radiance never leave you,
may there be no dark day in life in the family.
A little glass of l’chaim is worth drinking to the last drop,
when one meets with friends anew.

A little glass of l’chaim, for our great land,
may the heavens look down on us clear and pure.
A little glass of l’chaim, I wish you yet another and another,
may you go with a smile upon your lips.
A little glass of l’chaim—may joy always accompany you,
lively and spirited, may you never be parted.
A little glass of l’chaim, for everything that we enjoy
and for peace over the whole world.

title: Dorozhen'ka (Little Road)
description: Music: N. Ivanov Lyrics: S. Podelkov (1914)
lyrics_original:
Вьется, вьется дальняя дороженька,
Стелется за дымкой горизонт,
А по этой дальней по дороженьке
Вслед за милым еду я на фронт.

Он все чаще, чаще, чаще снится мне,
Как идет с полками в бой и дым...
Поднялась, рванулась бы я птицею,
Опустилась рядом бы я с ним.

Вьется, вьется вдаль моя дороженька,
За окном становится рассвет.
Я одна, одна стою у тополя,
И обидно сердцу - крыльев нет.
lyrics_english:
Winding, winding goes the long, long road,
The horizon stretches out through the haze;
And along this long, long road I travel,
Following my beloved to the front.

More and more often he appears in my dreams,
Marching with his regiments into battle and smoke...
Oh, to rise up and soar like a bird,
To alight right there beside him.

Winding, winding, my road stretches on,
Dawn is breaking outside the window.
I stand all alone by the poplar tree,
And my heart aches—for I have no wings.

title: Sunrise, Sunset
description: Composer: Jerry Bock, Lyrics: Sheldon Harnick (1964), Fiddler On The Roof
lyrics_english:
Is this the little girl I carried?
Is this the little boy at play?
I don't remember growing older
When did they?

When did she get to be a beauty?
When did he get to be so tall?
Wasn't it yesterday
When they were small?

Sunrise, sunset
Sunrise, sunset
Swiftly flow the days
Seedlings turn overnight to sunflowers
Blossoming even as we gaze
Sunrise, sunset
Sunrise, sunset
Swiftly fly the years
One season following another
Laden with happiness and tears

What words of wisdom can I give them?
How can I help to ease their way?
Now they must learn from one another
Day by day

They look so natural together
Just like two newlyweds should be
Is there a canopy in store for me?

Sunrise, sunset
Sunrise, sunset
Swiftly flow the days
Seedlings turn overnight to sunflowers
Blossoming even as we gaze
Sunrise, sunset
Sunrise, sunset
Swiftly fly the years
One season following another
Laden with happiness and tears

title: Ya lyublyu tevya, zhizn' (I Love You, Life)
description: Composer: Eduard Kolmanovsky, Lyrics: Konstantni Vanshenkin (1956), performed by Mark Bernes
lyrics_original:
Я люблю тебя, жизнь,
Что само по себе и не ново,
Я люблю тебя, жизнь,
Я люблю тебя снова и снова.

Вот уж окна зажглись,
Я шагаю с работы устало,
Я люблю тебя, жизнь,
И хочу, чтобы лучше ты стала.

Мне немало дано —
Ширь земли и равнина морская,
Мне известна давно
Бескорыстная дружба мужская…
lyrics_english:
I love you, life—
A sentiment hardly new—
I love you, life,
I love you, time and again.

The windows are lit up now;
I walk home from work, weary;
I love you, life,
And I want you to be better.
I have been given so much—

The vastness of earth and the open sea;
I have long known
The selfless friendship of men…

title: Mat' radnaya maya (My Dear Mother)
description: Composer: Platon Maiboroda, Lyrics: Andrii Malyshko (1958)
lyrics_original:
Мать родная моя, ты до зорьки вставала
И водила меня на поля из села.
Собрала в путь-дорогу и меня далеко провожала,
И расшитый рушник мне на счастье дала.
Собрала в путь-дорогу и меня далеко провожала,
И расшитый рушник мне на счастье, на долю дала.

Пусть сияет на нем, как весенняя сказка,
В соловьиную ночь расцветающий сад.
И любви материнской улыбнется мне тихая ласка,
И очей твоих синих задумчивый взгляд.
И любви материнской улыбнется мне тихая ласка,
И очей твоих синих печальный, задумчивый взгляд.

Я возьму тот рушник, расстелю, словно долю,
В тихом шелесте трав, в щебетанье дубров.
И на вышивке тонкой расцветет все родное до боли,
И разлука, и детство мое, и любовь.
И на вышивке тонкой расцветет все родное до боли,
И разлука, и детство, и матери милой любовь.
lyrics_english:
My own dear mother, you rose before dawn
And led me from the village out to the fields.
You readied me for the journey and saw me off on my way,
And gave me an embroidered towel for good fortune.
You readied me for the journey and saw me off on my way,
And gave me an embroidered towel for luck and for my destiny.

May a garden in bloom on a night of singing nightingales
Shine upon it like a fairytale of spring.
May the quiet tenderness of a mother's love smile upon me,
Along with the pensive gaze of your blue eyes.
May the quiet tenderness of a mother's love smile upon me,
Along with the sorrowful, pensive gaze of your blue eyes.

I shall take that towel and spread it out like my destiny,
Amidst the quiet rustle of grass and the warbling of the woods.
And upon the delicate embroidery, all that is dear—painfully so—will bloom:
The parting, my childhood, and love.
And upon the delicate embroidery, all that is dear—painfully so—will bloom:
The parting, my childhood, and my dear mother's love.

title: Lyubim'ye glaza (Beloved Eyes)
description: Composer: Andrey Babaev, Lyrics: Kara Seytliyev and Anisim Krongauz (1955)
lyrics_original:
Воды арыка бегут, как живые
Переливаясь, в журчаньи звеня
Возле арыка я помню, впервые
Глянули эти глаза на меня

В небе блещут звезды золотые
Ярче звезд очей твоих краса
Только у любимой могут быть такие
Необыкновенные глаза!

Где бы я ни был: в пустыне безбрежной
В море, в горах с пастухом у огня -
Эти глаза неотрывно и нежно
Мне помогая, глядят на меня

В небе блещут звезды золотые
Ярче звезд очей твоих краса
Только у любимой могут быть такие
Необыкновенные глаза!
lyrics_english:
The waters of the Aryk flow, alive and bright,
Rippling and chiming with a gentle sound;
Beside the stream, I recall the moment
Those eyes first gazed upon me.

Golden stars are gleaming in the sky,
Yet the beauty of your eyes outshines them all;
Only a beloved could possess such
Extraordinary eyes!

Wherever I may be—in the boundless desert,
At sea, or in the mountains by a shepherd's fire—
Those eyes gaze upon me, tender and unwavering,
Offering their support.

Golden stars are gleaming in the sky,
Yet the beauty of your eyes outshines them all;
Only a beloved could possess such
Extraordinary eyes!
